title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, default state and configuration instructions are supported by the roadmap, tenant notice and Microsoft Learn. One minor correction remains: the checklist asks administrators to check Facilitator app availability, but that control has no table row.

claims.claim: Roadmap 560318 concerns Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn warns that the experience and licensing model may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.claim: Facilitator already takes notes in scheduled Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator is an AI-powered agent in Teams that can automatically take notes of the conversations that happen during a meeting, provide key highlights, and answer prompts in the meeting chat.

claims.claim: Microsoft is extending Facilitator to unscheduled in-person discussions in Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Windows.

claims.claim: Facilitator captures notes, decisions and action items from in-person discussions without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.
claims.quote: This enhancement allows teams meeting in a physical room to capture real-time notes, decisions, and action items—without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Notes appear on the front-of-room display or touch board during the meeting.
claims.quote: Notes appear on the front-of-room display or touch board during the meeting

claims.claim: The roadmap says shared notes are available through meeting recap.
claims.quote: Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected.

claims.claim: The roadmap says notes are deleted if no one is selected.
claims.quote: are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected.

claims.claim: Participants with access can view and edit notes after the meeting via recap in meeting chat on the Teams desktop client.
claims.quote: After the meeting, notes can be viewed and edited by participants with access via the meeting recap in the meeting chat on the Teams desktop client.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Change & support
claims.claim: The tenant notice calls the access step Access notes and requires adding a work account.
claims.quote: Access to notes requires adding your work account using the Access notes button on the Teams Rooms console

claims.claim: The notice says notes are automatically deleted if no participant was added through Access notes during the session.
claims.quote: If no participant was added during the note-taking session via Access notes, notes are deleted automatically.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn calls the step Save notes and says to add participants' names in its dialog for later access.
claims.quote: At the end of the session, select Save notes and ensure participants’ names are added in the dialog pop-up so they can access the notes and transcript later on their personal devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn says unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.
claims.quote: Unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.

claims.claim: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting.
claims.quote: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting.

claims.claim: Facilitator does not record the meeting.
claims.quote: The meeting won't be recorded.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn still describes in-person note-taking as preview, in contrast to the roadmap and notice's General Availability phase.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate summaries, decisions and action items.
claims.quote: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate AI‑powered meeting notes, including summaries, decisions, and action items.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Room notes are stored in tenant-owned SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Meeting notes generated by Facilitator are stored in tenant‑owned SharePoint Embedded storage.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn describes the AI-generated room notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant

claims.claim: Room notes data is treated as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.claim: The notice says no meeting data remains stored or cached on the room device after the meeting.
claims.quote: No meeting data is stored or cached on the Teams Rooms device after the meeting ends.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say notes do not inherit the meeting's sensitivity label.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.

claims.claim: Learn says Prevent copy and paste is not applied to Facilitator responses or notes in meetings.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says meeting watermarks are not applied to Facilitator responses or notes in meetings.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says Facilitator meeting notes are not automatically collected as eDiscovery cloud attachments.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The documented meetings limitations do not specifically establish their applicability to unscheduled in-person room notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in person Teams Rooms sensitivity label watermark eDiscovery limitations. Read facilitator-teams, rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; none specifically resolves these limits for unscheduled room notes.

claims.claim: Only participants who add their names at the beginning and have enrolled profiles are identified and attributed.
claims.quote: Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Facilitator app must be enabled for the room resource account.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: A room account must be included when Facilitator availability is scoped to People and Groups.
claims.quote: If app availability is set to Everyone, the room account is included. If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.claim: Muting the room microphone prevents Facilitator or transcription from capturing content.
claims.quote: You can mute the microphone in the room to ensure Facilitator or transcription doesn't capture any content.

claims.claim: The portal's Show Take notes button on the home screen setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.claim: Learn's setup steps for in-person room note-taking list no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in-person notes meter credits usage charge pricing. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms: the in-person setup lists Teams Rooms Pro; the separate scheduled-meetings section names Copilot.

claims.claim: The cited feature and licensing pages document no feature-specific meter, credit rate or usage charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in-person notes meter credits usage charge pricing. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms, facilitator-teams, rooms/rooms-licensing and rooms/rooms-release-note; found inclusion in Pro, not a feature usage meter.

claims.claim: The cited Teams Rooms licences comparison page gives no Teams Rooms Pro price.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms licenses" "Pro" "price". Opened and read rooms/rooms-licensing in full; it compares Basic and Pro and describes purchasing but prints no Pro price. The briefing limits the absence to that page and 'here'.

claims.claim: The Loop admin policy page says Loop file storage, including SharePoint Embedded, counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by .loop files (earlier releases created .fluid files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.claim: Learn's FAQ says Facilitator is available on Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Facilitator is available on Teams Rooms on Windows

claims.claim: Learn's FAQ projects Facilitator for Teams Rooms on Android in a future release.
claims.quote: is projected to release on Teams Rooms on Android in a future release.

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to ensure Facilitator is enabled in the tenant.
claims.quote: Ensure Facilitator is enabled in your tenant.

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to verify IsLoopEnabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to verify IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to enable meeting transcription in Teams meeting policies.
claims.quote: Ensure meeting transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.

claims.claim: The documented portal path is Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for the portal's Take notes home-screen setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms "Show Take notes" PowerShell Graph API Pro Management settings; "Show Take notes button" "API". Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms, rooms/pro-portal-settings and the rooms/xml-config-file search excerpt; no setting API found.

claims.claim: The Teams admin center transcription path is Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the selected meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Learn's room setup links the general transcription policy without specifying which policy is evaluated for the in-person room session.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator "transcription" "policy" "resource account". Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and meeting-transcription-captions plus rooms/copilot-admin-mtr excerpts; no explicit policy evaluation rule for this unscheduled scenario found.

claims.claim: No admin UI for the two Teams-specific SharePoint Loop properties is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center user interface settings. Read loop/loop-components-configuration; UI controls govern workspaces and other integrations, while the two Teams properties use SharePoint PowerShell.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true; Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables the two Teams Loop settings using SharePoint PowerShell.
claims.quote: [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.claim: Both Teams Loop SharePoint settings apply tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property does not apply to Teams New Calendar, for which Learn points to Cloud Policy.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: The Loop page describes its Cloud Policy settings as covering Loop experiences except Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages, Copilot Notebooks, and the Loop experiences (except for Microsoft Teams) check the following Cloud Policy settings.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the Take notes button's behaviour when a prerequisite is missing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "Take notes" "prerequisites" missing disabled. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and rooms/pro-portal-settings; the former states what appears after prerequisites are met, not the button's failure behaviour.

claims.claim: The Teams admin center path to allow or block Facilitator is Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.
In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default. However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: Saved room notes can be found through the meeting chat's Recap tab.
claims.quote: To access notes after the meeting, navigate to the Teams meeting chat titled “Meeting with [conference room name].” At the top of the meeting chat, select the Recap tab, and then select Notes to find the AI-generated notes and transcript.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Every control that the governance checklist asks administrators to check has a controls-table row.
claims.quote: Confirm the Facilitator app is allowed for those room accounts, using the Teams admin center steps in the notes below the table. / The table contains only Take notes, transcription and Loop rows.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet 'Confirm the Facilitator app is allowed for those room accounts, using the Teams admin center steps in the notes below the table.' Keep the documented app steps below the table; do not add a control row.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: For the Pro-licensed rooms in scope, low cost reflects included functionality plus administration and helpdesk work.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.
